groups.name: pll
groups.why: LMX2541 PLL/VCO (U1) with its supply ferrites and decaps, the 108 MHz VCXO U2, splitter U3, loop filter, lock LED D1/Q1, ref-in SMA J1 and ext-VCO SMA J2 (PLL sheet)

groups.name: mixers
groups.why: PMA2-43LN+ amps U21/U22 with bias tees, GAT-5 pad U23, QCN-34 quadrature splitter U24, splitter U25, SIM-73L mixers U26/U27 (Frequency mixers sheet); IF out goes to the ADC

groups.name: adc
groups.why: ADS8694 ADC U29, its LTC6655 ref U30 and OPA2209 Butterworth front end U28 (ADC sheet); C110-C113, R116, R118, R123, R124 have no symbol but sit on U28/U29 filter nets

groups.name: digital
groups.why: 80-pin QSH board-to-board connector J5 (back) with the LVDS receivers/drivers U31/U32/U34/U38 and LV4T125 level shifters U33/U35/U36/U37 (digital interface sheet)

groups.name: ldo_pos
groups.why: five TPS7A4700 positive LDOs U39-U43, their input/output caps and status-LED resistors (PSU sheet); the LEDs D2-D8 are declared at fixed poses top-left

groups.name: power_in
groups.why: 6-pin Molex power entry J6 with its three NFM41 EMI filters L12-L14, bulk Al caps and test points TP1-TP9 (PSU sheet blocks B40/B41/B46/B47/B49/B53/B56/B57)

groups.name: ldo_neg
groups.why: two TPS7A3301 negative LDOs U44/U45 with their feedback dividers, caps and LED resistors (PSU sheet)

groups.name: dac
groups.why: LTC2758 dual DAC U4 with its reference buffers U5/U6/U7/U8 and output amps U9-U11 (DAC sheet)

groups.name: dac_if
groups.why: LTC6655 refs U12/U13 and LT6600 differential filters U14/U15 that drive the IQ modulator I/Q inputs (DAC Interface sheet)

groups.name: iqmod
groups.why: HMC1097 IQ modulator U16 with splitter U17 and its coupling/bypass caps (IQ modulator sheet); its I/Q baseband comes from dac_if

groups.name: dividers
groups.why: three HMC705 dividers U18-U20 with their decaps and config resistors, divider outputs to SMA J3/J4 (Frequency dividers sheet); R83 (no symbol) is U19 config pull

groups.name: fence_J7
groups.why: block of the custom shield fence J7-position: the F-face parts the human board has under can J7; the placer keeps a ring round it (fence_mm 2.0: nothing else in its bounding box + 2 mm)
